title: Modifications of a complete 2-dimensional local domain are projective

standard_prerequisites.name: Projectivity criterion over a complete base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms of Spaces, lemma projective-over-complete (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces projectivity of a modification over the complete base to the special fibre having dimension at most 1.

standard_prerequisites.name: Special fibre dimension bound
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies dim <= dim(A) - 1 = 1 for the special fibre of a modification.

core_obligations: By the projective-over-complete criterion it suffices to show the special fibre of any modification X of Spec(A) has dimension at most 1.
A modification satisfies condition (1) of the dimension-special-fibre lemma, and dim(A) = 2, so dim of the special fibre is at most 1.
proof_roadmap: Criterion reduction; application of the special-fibre dimension bound.
difficulty_reason: A short reduction proof; the substantive step is matching the modification hypothesis to condition (1) of the dimension lemma and evaluating dim(A) - 1 = 1.
